\par\smallskip
\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\footnotesize Jensen term: the difference between the northward-limb transport from the monthly fields and from the annual fields, with its percent share of the mean monthly-field transport. Depth shares are shares of the absolute transport weight on the levels of the vertical decomposition (41 levels). Band trends are layer means of the salinity trend profile; ratios are reanalysis to EN4 and are not interpreted below 2000 m, where the EN4 trends are near zero. EN4 means use each reanalysis circulation frozen at its record mean (Methods), with the 95\% interval stored with each mean. Panel (e) gives the upper-cell total, its transport and contrast terms, and the abyssal trend of ORAS5 for the windows 1958--2025, 1993--2017 and 2004--2025; the last column is the effective sample size of each trend. Panel (f) gives the upper-cell residual of the identity (sieve bootstrap interval) and the total freshwater transport trends with and without the removal of the net section transport (bias-corrected test intervals).\end{minipage}
